name: Exemestane
description: A steroidal aromatase inactivator that binds the enzyme irreversibly, approved for hormone-receptor-positive breast cancer. Its steroidal structure carries mild intrinsic androgenic activity.

systems.note: Irreversible inactivation of aromatase; the intended pharmacology.
Estrogen deprivation reduces bone mineral density; labelled.
Adverse lipid movement under estrogen deprivation.

monitors.why: The direct index of effect; recovery is slower than with reversible inhibitors.
